Home · Services · Laser

Treatment

Laser

Laser treatments for hair reduction and selected skin concerns, planned after assessment.

About the treatment

Laser devices use focused light to target structures such as hair follicles or pigment. Different concerns need different devices and settings, so the first step is to assess your skin and the area you want to treat.

Tell us about recent tanning, medicines and previous laser treatments. We will explain which options are available for hair reduction or your skin concern, along with the likely course and recovery.

At a glance

  • Hair reduction on suitable face and body areas
  • Assessment of pigmentation concerns
  • Discussion of options for skin texture and tone
  • Settings chosen for your skin and treatment area
  • Preparation and aftercare explained before treatment

The treatment process

  1. Consultation and assessment. We check your skin tone, hair or pigment concern, medical history and recent sun exposure.
  2. A personal plan. We explain the treatment options, likely results, possible side effects and cost before you decide.
  3. The treatment itself. We talk you through the session and check how you feel as we go.
  4. Aftercare and follow up. We explain how to care for the treated area and when to contact us or return for a review.

Expected results

Hair reduction usually develops over several sessions because hair grows in cycles. Skin treatment results depend on the concern and device used. We will review your response before adjusting the plan.

Recovery & downtime

Redness, warmth or sensitivity may occur after laser treatment. Recovery depends on the device, settings and area. We will explain sun protection, which skincare products to pause and when you can resume your usual activities.

Who is it for?

Hair colour, skin tone, recent tanning and medical history affect suitability. Pigmentation also needs assessment before treatment. We will explain the options and whether a test area is needed.

Frequently asked questions

Does laser hair removal hurt?
You may feel brief heat or a snapping sensation. Cooling can help, but sensitivity varies by area and person. Tell the team how it feels so they can check your comfort throughout.
Is laser safe for darker skin tones?
Some laser devices and settings can suit darker skin tones, but assessment is essential. We will consider your skin type, tanning and the risks of burns or pigment changes before recommending treatment.
Why do I need multiple sessions?
Hair grows in cycles, and laser works best on follicles in an active growth phase. Several sessions are usually needed. The number and spacing depend on the area, hair characteristics and your response.
Session time 15 to 60 minutes
